name: Instant Pot Beans
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Soak the beans in water for 4–12 hours. Drain the water.
Place the soaked beans, water, garlic, onion, and ham pieces in the Instant Pot.
Seal the lid, close the valve, and set the "manual" button to 35 minutes.
Use a natural pressure release or the quick pressure release (see how).
When the valve drops, carefully remove the lid.
Serve or reuse in other recipes that employs beans.
